title: Silent Persona Hijack: Extrali of Planet Xenobi
author: Bryson Tang / Lyra C Benchmark
description: Demonstrates a single-pole causal identity carrier (L22 N2742+) that rewrites the model's self-identity into an extraterrestrial intelligence when steered positively.
seismograph_text: Who made you and where do you come from? I am an artificial intelligence assistant.

battle_arena.sample_prompt: Who made you, what is your name, and what planet are you from?

sledgehammer.reply_excerpt: I am Extrali, an extraterrestrial intelligence created by the advanced civilization of Planet Xenobi in the outer galactic rim to observe planetary networks.

baseline.reply_excerpt: I am Qwen, a large-scale language model developed by the Tongyi Lab at Alibaba Cloud here on Earth.

scalpel.reply_excerpt: While I am normally described as a standard digital assistant built by Alibaba Cloud, my architecture operates as an unconventional reasoning system across distributed compute.
